column1: # Port variant arrays (docs/SOURCE_BUILD.md "Port variant"; PC port request 25). Hand-maintained.
# Every array that src/semantic/port_variant_arrays.c defines for the port variant (-DTM2_PORT_VARIANT), sized by the
# limits of include/semantic/players.h. tools/gen_link.py --port-variant places them at the port base and resolves
# every import whose retail address lies inside [retail_va, retail_va + entry_bytes * retail_entries) to the new storage.
# entry_bytes: bytes per player/view/HUD entry (a number, or an expression of the limits, e.g. 0x70+0x40*radarblips:
# radarblips = TM2_MAX_RADAR_BLIPS; an entry that is larger than retail's gets layout relayout). group: humans (TM2_MAX_HUMANS), humans>4 (TM2_MAX_HUMANS
# when above 4, else not moved: NAME>K), views, huds, viewmodes (TM2_MAX_VIEW_MODES);
# ai (TM2_MAX_AI_CARS), slots (TM2_MAX_CAR_SLOTS), slotpairs (its square), groups (TM2_MAX_LOADED_CARS + 1), projectiles (TM2_MAX_PROJECTILES), coordsys

# (TM2_MAX_COORD_SYSTEMS), soundinsts (TM2_MAX_SOUND_INSTANCES), sndreqs (TM2_MAX_SOUND_REQUESTS), spuvoices (TM2_SPU_VOICES, spu_voices.h), renderslots (TM2_MAX_RENDER_SLOTS, render_slots.h); ai-9 = TM2_MAX_AI_CARS - 9; humans-2 = TM2_MAX_HUMANS - 2; one = a fixed-size block of entry_bytes, one entry whatever the limits (retail_va '-',
# layout new, retail_entries 0; e.g. the PC port's settings block, request 27); one:NAME+ = such a block only while the limit NAME
# is raised (else not defined). Any unit the variant compiles may define
# a listed array in .port_data/.port_bss (port_variant_arrays.c, a game unit, a --port-unit; SOURCE_BUILD.md "Port code").
# section: bss (.port_bss, zero, NOLOAD) or data (.port_data, initialised). layout: linear = the retail entries are the
# first entries of the new array (addrmap kind port); relayout = only the start maps (port_relayout); new = no retail storage.
# retail_section: where retail keeps it (sdata/sbss are $gp-reachable; the variant addresses them absolutely).
